```{R}
# ============================================================
# 0) Packages
# ============================================================
library(here)
library(bruceR)
library(tidyverse)
library(openxlsx)
library(mirt)
library(ggplot2)
library(treemapify)
library(papaja)
library(patchwork)

```

```{R}
# ============================================================
# 1) 数据读取与预处理（基本保持原逻辑）
# ============================================================

# 1.1 读取原始数据
raw_data <- bruceR::import(here::here("data", "Raw_output.xlsx"))

# 1.2 只保留分析所需变量
selected_data <- raw_data %>%
  select(
    ID, Gender, Age,
    DSRSC1:DSRSC18,
    PHQ1:PHQ9,
    DASS3, DASS5, DASS10, DASS13, DASS16, DASS17, DASS21,
    CDI1:CDI27
  )

# 1.3 类型转换：Gender 男=1，女=2；其余转数值
selected_data_numeric <- selected_data %>%
  mutate(Gender = factor(Gender, levels = c("男", "女"), labels = c(1, 2))) %>%
  mutate(across(matches("Gender|Age|DSRSC|PHQ|DASS|CDI"), as.numeric))

# 1.4 缺失值处理
clean_data <- selected_data_numeric %>%
  drop_na()

# 1.5 原始数据 -1，统一到量表正常起点
transformed_data <- clean_data %>%
  mutate(across(matches("DSRSC|PHQ|DASS|CDI"), ~ .x - 1))

# 1.6 年龄筛选：7-18 岁
filtered_data <- transformed_data %>%
  filter(Age >= 7 & Age <= 18)

# 1.7 反向计分
CDI_reverse_items <- c(
  "CDI2", "CDI5", "CDI7", "CDI8", "CDI10",
  "CDI11", "CDI13", "CDI15", "CDI16",
  "CDI18", "CDI21", "CDI24", "CDI25"
)

DSRSC_reverse_items <- c(
  "DSRSC3", "DSRSC5", "DSRSC6", "DSRSC10",
  "DSRSC14", "DSRSC15", "DSRSC17", "DSRSC18"
)

analysis_data <- filtered_data %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(CDI_reverse_items), ~ 2 - .x)) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(DSRSC_reverse_items), ~ 2 - .x))

# 1.8 题目列表
dsrsc_items <- grep("^DSRSC", names(analysis_data), value = TRUE)
phq_items   <- grep("^PHQ", names(analysis_data), value = TRUE)
dass_items  <- grep("^DASS", names(analysis_data), value = TRUE)
cdi_items_all <- grep("^CDI", names(analysis_data), value = TRUE)
cdi_items_scored <- setdiff(cdi_items_all, "CDI26")   # CDI26 不计分

# 1.9 输出目录
dir.create(here::here("figure"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(here::here("output"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# 1.10 描述统计
gender_proportion <- analysis_data %>%
  summarise(
    male = sum(Gender == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    female = sum(Gender == 2, na.rm = TRUE),
    total = n(),
    male_proportion = male / total * 100,
    female_proportion = female / total * 100
  )

age_range <- analysis_data %>%
  summarise(
    min_age = min(Age, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_age = max(Age, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

cat("==== 性别比例 ====\n")
print(gender_proportion)

cat("\n==== 年龄范围 ====\n")
print(age_range)
```

```{R}
# ============================================================
# 2) 通用设置与函数
# ============================================================

# 2.1 原始 cutoff
cutoff_DSRSC <- 15
cutoff_PHQ   <- 10
cutoff_CDI   <- 20
cutoff_DASS_male   <- 4
cutoff_DASS_female <- 5

# 2.2 年龄分组
age_groups <- list(
  "7-12"  = 7:12,
  "13-15" = 13:15,
  "16-18" = 16:18
)

# 2.3 安全计算百分比
calc_rate <- function(df, det_col) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  mean(df[[det_col]], na.rm = TRUE) * 100
}

# 2.4 overlap 分组函数
build_overlap_counts <- function(df, det_prefix) {
  df %>%
    transmute(
      ID,
      DSRSC = as.integer(.data[[paste0(det_prefix, "DSRSC")]]),
      PHQ   = as.integer(.data[[paste0(det_prefix, "PHQ")]]),
      CDI   = as.integer(.data[[paste0(det_prefix, "CDI")]]),
      DASS  = as.integer(.data[[paste0(det_prefix, "DASS")]])
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      total_detected = DSRSC + PHQ + CDI + DASS,
      group = case_when(
        total_detected == 4 ~ "All four detected",

        total_detected == 3 & DSRSC == 0 ~ "Only PHQ + CDI + DASS",
        total_detected == 3 & PHQ == 0 ~ "Only DSRSC + CDI + DASS",
        total_detected == 3 & CDI == 0 ~ "Only DSRSC + PHQ + DASS",
        total_detected == 3 & DASS == 0 ~ "Only DSRSC + PHQ + CDI",

        total_detected == 2 & DSRSC == 1 & PHQ == 1 ~ "Only DSRSC + PHQ",
        total_detected == 2 & DSRSC == 1 & CDI == 1 ~ "Only DSRSC + CDI",
        total_detected == 2 & DSRSC == 1 & DASS == 1 ~ "Only DSRSC + DASS",
        total_detected == 2 & PHQ == 1 & CDI == 1 ~ "Only PHQ + CDI",
        total_detected == 2 & PHQ == 1 & DASS == 1 ~ "Only PHQ + DASS",
        total_detected == 2 & CDI == 1 & DASS == 1 ~ "Only CDI + DASS",

        total_detected == 1 & DSRSC == 1 ~ "Only DSRSC",
        total_detected == 1 & PHQ == 1 ~ "Only PHQ",
        total_detected == 1 & CDI == 1 ~ "Only CDI",
        total_detected == 1 & DASS == 1 ~ "Only DASS",

        TRUE ~ "Other/Unclassified"
      ),
      level = case_when(
        total_detected == 4 ~ "4_detected",
        total_detected == 3 ~ "3_detected",
        total_detected == 2 ~ "2_detected",
        total_detected == 1 ~ "1_detected",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(group != "Other/Unclassified", level != "Other") %>%
    group_by(group, level) %>%
    summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(count > 0) %>%
    arrange(desc(count))
}

# 2.5 年龄组折线图数据函数
build_age_line_data <- function(df, prefix) {
  age_data <- purrr::map_dfr(names(age_groups), function(g) {
    ages <- age_groups[[g]]
    tmp <- df %>% filter(Age %in% ages)

    tibble(
      Age_Group = g,
      Measure = c("DSRSC", "PHQ-9", "CDI", "DASS"),
      Detection_Rate = c(
        calc_rate(tmp, paste0(prefix, "DSRSC")),
        calc_rate(tmp, paste0(prefix, "PHQ")),
        calc_rate(tmp, paste0(prefix, "CDI")),
        calc_rate(tmp, paste0(prefix, "DASS"))
      )
    )
  })

  overall_data <- tibble(
    Age_Group = "Overall",
    Measure = c("DSRSC", "PHQ-9", "CDI", "DASS"),
    Detection_Rate = c(
      calc_rate(df, paste0(prefix, "DSRSC")),
      calc_rate(df, paste0(prefix, "PHQ")),
      calc_rate(df, paste0(prefix, "CDI")),
      calc_rate(df, paste0(prefix, "DASS"))
    )
  )

  out <- bind_rows(overall_data, age_data) %>%
    mutate(Age_Group = factor(Age_Group, levels = c("Overall", "7-12", "13-15", "16-18")))

  mean_order <- out %>%
    group_by(Measure) %>%
    summarise(Average_Detection_Rate = mean(Detection_Rate, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(Average_Detection_Rate))

  out$Measure <- factor(out$Measure, levels = mean_order$Measure)
  out
}
```

```{R}
# ============================================================
# 3) 协调前（Pre-harmonization）
# ============================================================

# 3.1 原始总分
pre_dsrsc_total <- rowSums(analysis_data[, dsrsc_items], na.rm = TRUE)
pre_phq_total   <- rowSums(analysis_data[, phq_items], na.rm = TRUE)
pre_cdi_total   <- rowSums(analysis_data[, cdi_items_scored], na.rm = TRUE)
pre_dass_total  <- rowSums(analysis_data[, dass_items], na.rm = TRUE)

# 3.2 DASS 个体阈值
pre_dass_cutoff <- ifelse(analysis_data$Gender == 1, cutoff_DASS_male, cutoff_DASS_female)

# 3.3 协调前检出标记
pre_data <- analysis_data %>%
  transmute(
    ID,
    Gender,
    Age,
    pre_dsrsc_total = pre_dsrsc_total,
    pre_phq_total   = pre_phq_total,
    pre_cdi_total   = pre_cdi_total,
    pre_dass_total  = pre_dass_total,
    pre_det_DSRSC = pre_dsrsc_total >= cutoff_DSRSC,
    pre_det_PHQ   = pre_phq_total   >= cutoff_PHQ,
    pre_det_CDI   = pre_cdi_total   >= cutoff_CDI,
    pre_det_DASS  = pre_dass_total  >= pre_dass_cutoff
  )

# 3.4 协调前 treemap 数据
pre_group_counts <- build_overlap_counts(pre_data, "pre_det_")

# 3.5 协调前年龄组折线数据
pre_line_data <- build_age_line_data(pre_data, "pre_det_")

# 3.6 协调前折线图
p_pre_line <- ggplot(
  pre_line_data,
  aes(x = Measure, y = Detection_Rate, group = Age_Group, color = Age_Group)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  papaja::theme_apa(base_size = 22) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Detection Rate (%)",
    title = "Pre-harmonization Detection Rates by Measure and Age Group"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Overall" = "gray40",
    "7-12"    = "#2ca02c",
    "13-15"   = "#1f77b4",
    "16-18"   = "#ff7f0e"
  )) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 80), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0.2, 0)) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(title = "Group"))

# 3.7 协调前 treemap
p_pre_treemap <- ggplot(
  pre_group_counts,
  aes(area = count, fill = level, label = paste0(group, "\n", count))
) +
  geom_treemap() +
  geom_treemap_text(colour = "white", place = "centre", grow = TRUE, reflow = TRUE) +
  papaja::theme_apa(base_size = 22) +
  labs(
    title = "Pre-harmonization: Distribution of Detection Condition",
    fill = "Detected Level"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "4_detected" = "#08306b",
    "3_detected" = "#2171b5",
    "2_detected" = "#6baed6",
    "1_detected" = "#c6dbef"
  ))

# 3.8 协调前组合图
p_pre_combined <- p_pre_line + p_pre_treemap +
  plot_layout(ncol = 2) +
  plot_annotation(
    tag_levels = "A",
    theme = theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"))
  )

# 3.9 导出
ggsave(
  here::here("figure", "pre_final_combined_plot.png"),
  p_pre_combined, width = 20, height = 6, dpi = 300
)

openxlsx::write.xlsx(
  pre_line_data %>% mutate(Detection_Rate = round(Detection_Rate, 2)),
  here::here("output", "pre_detection_rates_by_age.xlsx"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

openxlsx::write.xlsx(
  pre_group_counts,
  here::here("output", "pre_treemap_group_counts.xlsx"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

cat("\n==== 协调前 treemap 组合人数 ====\n")
print(pre_group_counts)

cat("\n==== 协调前年龄组检出率 ====\n")
print(pre_line_data)


```

```{R}
# ============================================================
# 4) 数据协调（Harmonization）
# ============================================================

# 4.1 全题数据
harm_data0 <- analysis_data %>%
  select(all_of(c(dsrsc_items, phq_items, dass_items, cdi_items_scored)))

# 4.2 共同单维 GRM
harm_fit_all <- mirt(harm_data0, 1, itemtype = "graded", SE = FALSE)

# 4.3 构建 crosswalk 函数
build_walk <- function(scale_dat, fit_all_model) {
  tmp <- mirt(scale_dat, 1, itemtype = "graded")
  sv2 <- mod2values(tmp)
  uni <- mod2values(fit_all_model)

  # 优先使用 item + name + class 联合匹配；
  # 若 class 列不存在，则退回 item + name
  if (all(c("item", "name", "class") %in% names(sv2)) &&
      all(c("item", "name", "class") %in% names(uni))) {

    sv2$key <- paste(sv2$item, sv2$name, sv2$class, sep = " | ")
    uni$key <- paste(uni$item, uni$name, uni$class, sep = " | ")

  } else {

    sv2$key <- paste(sv2$item, sv2$name, sep = " | ")
    uni$key <- paste(uni$item, uni$name, sep = " | ")
  }

  idx <- match(sv2$key, uni$key)

  if (any(is.na(idx))) {
    bad_cols <- intersect(c("item", "name", "class"), names(sv2))
    bad <- sv2[is.na(idx), bad_cols, drop = FALSE]
    message("以下参数在共同模型中找不到（前30个）：")
    print(head(bad, 30))
    stop("Crosswalk 参数匹配失败：通常是题目命名不一致，或 itemtype / 类别数不一致。")
  }

  # 再检查是否仍有重复匹配
  if (length(unique(idx)) != length(idx)) {
    stop("联合匹配后仍存在重复匹配，需进一步检查。")
  }

  sv2$value <- uni$value[idx]
  sv2$est <- FALSE

  walk <- mirt(scale_dat, 1, itemtype = "graded", pars = sv2)

  list(
    walk = walk,
    eap = fscores(walk, method = "EAP", full.scores.SE = FALSE),
    eapsum = fscores(walk, method = "EAPsum", full.scores = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

# 4.4 各量表拟合
walk_DSRSC <- build_walk(analysis_data %>% select(all_of(dsrsc_items)), harm_fit_all)
walk_PHQ   <- build_walk(analysis_data %>% select(all_of(phq_items)),   harm_fit_all)
walk_DASS  <- build_walk(analysis_data %>% select(all_of(dass_items)),  harm_fit_all)
walk_CDI <- build_walk(analysis_data %>% select(all_of(cdi_items_scored)), harm_fit_all)

harm_DSRSCeap    <- as.data.frame(walk_DSRSC$eap)
harm_PHQeap      <- as.data.frame(walk_PHQ$eap)
harm_DASSeap     <- as.data.frame(walk_DASS$eap)
harm_CDIeap      <- as.data.frame(walk_CDI$eap)

harm_DSRSCeapsum <- as.data.frame(walk_DSRSC$eapsum)
harm_PHQeapsum   <- as.data.frame(walk_PHQ$eapsum)
harm_DASSeapsum  <- as.data.frame(walk_DASS$eapsum)
harm_CDIeapsum   <- as.data.frame(walk_CDI$eapsum)

# 4.5 原始 cutoff -> theta cutoff
harm_cutoff_theta_DSRSC <- harm_DSRSCeapsum$F1[harm_DSRSCeapsum$Sum.Scores == cutoff_DSRSC]
harm_cutoff_theta_PHQ   <- harm_PHQeapsum$F1[harm_PHQeapsum$Sum.Scores == cutoff_PHQ]
harm_cutoff_theta_CDI   <- harm_CDIeapsum$F1[harm_CDIeapsum$Sum.Scores == cutoff_CDI]
harm_cutoff_theta_DASS_male   <- harm_DASSeapsum$F1[harm_DASSeapsum$Sum.Scores == cutoff_DASS_male]
harm_cutoff_theta_DASS_female <- harm_DASSeapsum$F1[harm_DASSeapsum$Sum.Scores == cutoff_DASS_female]

stopifnot(
  length(harm_cutoff_theta_DSRSC) == 1,
  length(harm_cutoff_theta_PHQ) == 1,
  length(harm_cutoff_theta_CDI) == 1,
  length(harm_cutoff_theta_DASS_male) == 1,
  length(harm_cutoff_theta_DASS_female) == 1
)

```

```{R}
# ============================================================
# 5) 协调后（Post-harmonization）
# ============================================================

# 5.1 theta 主表 + 协调后检出标记
harm_data <- tibble(
  ID = analysis_data$ID,
  Gender = analysis_data$Gender,
  Age = analysis_data$Age,
  harm_theta_DSRSC = as.numeric(harm_DSRSCeap$F1),
  harm_theta_PHQ   = as.numeric(harm_PHQeap$F1),
  harm_theta_DASS  = as.numeric(harm_DASSeap$F1),
  harm_theta_CDI   = as.numeric(harm_CDIeap$F1)
) %>%
  mutate(
    harm_det_DSRSC = harm_theta_DSRSC >= harm_cutoff_theta_DSRSC,
    harm_det_PHQ   = harm_theta_PHQ   >= harm_cutoff_theta_PHQ,
    harm_det_CDI   = harm_theta_CDI   >= harm_cutoff_theta_CDI,
    harm_det_DASS  = ifelse(
      Gender == 1,
      harm_theta_DASS >= harm_cutoff_theta_DASS_male,
      harm_theta_DASS >= harm_cutoff_theta_DASS_female
    )
  )

# 5.2 协调后 treemap 数据
harm_group_counts <- build_overlap_counts(harm_data, "harm_det_")

# 5.3 协调后折线图数据
harm_line_data <- build_age_line_data(harm_data, "harm_det_")

# 5.4 协调后折线图
p_harm_line <- ggplot(
  harm_line_data,
  aes(x = Measure, y = Detection_Rate, group = Age_Group, color = Age_Group)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  papaja::theme_apa(base_size = 22) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Detection Rate (%)",
    title = "Post-harmonization Detection Rates by Measure and Age Group"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Overall" = "gray40",
    "7-12"    = "#2ca02c",
    "13-15"   = "#1f77b4",
    "16-18"   = "#ff7f0e"
  )) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 80), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0.2, 0)) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(title = "Group"))

# 5.5 协调后 treemap
p_harm_treemap <- ggplot(
  harm_group_counts,
  aes(area = count, fill = level, label = paste0(group, "\n", count))
) +
  geom_treemap() +
  geom_treemap_text(colour = "white", place = "centre", grow = TRUE, reflow = TRUE) +
  papaja::theme_apa(base_size = 22) +
  labs(
    title = "Post-harmonization: Distribution of Detection Condition",
    fill = "Detected Level"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "4_detected" = "#08306b",
    "3_detected" = "#2171b5",
    "2_detected" = "#6baed6",
    "1_detected" = "#c6dbef"
  ))

# 5.6 协调后组合图
p_harm_combined <- p_harm_line + p_harm_treemap +
  plot_layout(ncol = 2) +
  plot_annotation(
    tag_levels = "A",
    theme = theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"))
  )

# 5.7 导出
ggsave(
  here::here("figure", "harm_final_combined_plot.png"),
  p_harm_combined, width = 20, height = 6, dpi = 300
)

openxlsx::write.xlsx(
  harm_line_data %>% mutate(Detection_Rate = round(Detection_Rate, 2)),
  here::here("output", "harm_detection_rates_by_age.xlsx"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

openxlsx::write.xlsx(
  harm_group_counts,
  here::here("output", "harm_treemap_group_counts.xlsx"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

cat("\n==== 协调后 treemap 组合人数 ====\n")
print(harm_group_counts)

cat("\n==== 协调后年龄组检出率 ====\n")
print(harm_line_data)

```

p_final_compare <- p_pre_combined / p_harm_combined +
  plot_annotation(
    tag_levels = "A",

      plot.tag = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 20)
